subject: Recap & commitments — LumenHealth infra constraints, compliance drivers, and next steps
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Karina Lopez <karina.lopez@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: LumenHealth IT <it@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Recap from today — infra constraints, compliance drivers, and suggested next steps

Hi Karina — thanks for the time today. Quick recap so we're aligned and can move to the technical deep-dive with your network team.

TL;DR: LumenHealth is evaluating a private/VPC-hosted deployment of Redwood for PHI workloads. Primary constraints: strict data residency (US-only), an air-gapped-ish posture for certain environments (no public inbound endpoints), restrictive outbound egress controls, and a KMS/HSM requirement for key custody. Goal is a short POC (6–8 weeks) to validate latency and auditability before a broader rollout.

What we heard (pain points & drivers)
- Regulatory: HIPAA + internal audit requirements — audit logs and key custody are must-haves.
- Network: limited internet egress from your processing subnets, prefer private peering or ExpressRoute-like connectivity, and a small set of approved outbound IPs.
- Security: on-prem KMS or KMS integration via customer-managed keys; MFA and SSO for admin plane.
- Timeline & success criteria: POC goal = token-level latency < 250ms p95 (for 512-token prompts), end-to-end traceability, and no PHI leaving US-resident infrastructure.

Committed next pieces from Redwood
1) Technical deep-dive with network ops + solutions eng (60–90m). We'll bring Marissa from Solutions Eng to lead the session.
2) Network requirements template (attached) to capture firewall rules, egress allowances, DNS, and proxy behavior.
3) A short mutual action plan (MoAP) outlining milestones, owners, and a 6–8 week POC timeline.
4) SOC2 / privacy brief and list of expected evidence we can produce (attached).

Requests from LumenHealth
- Please confirm the right network ops contact and their preferred calendar windows.
- Provide your current network topology (if available) and any existing peering/IP allowlist constraints.

Attachments included: network-requirements-template.pdf (Redwood), redwood-privacy-brief.pdf

Proposed slots for the deep-dive (PST): Mon 12/14 10:00–11:30, Tue 12/15 09:00–10:30, Wed 12/16 13:00–14:30. Let me know what works and who from your side will join.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting Marissa and our infra team aligned with your ops folks.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Karina Lopez <karina.lopez@lumenhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: LumenHealth IT <it@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap from today — infra constraints, compliance drivers, and suggested next steps

Thanks Sean — good summary. Confirming a few items from our side:
- Yep, HIPAA + internal SOC requirements. We'll need an architecture where sensitive workloads do not traverse public internet egress; private peering or AWS PrivateLink-like connectivity preferred.
- Our network ops lead is Miguel Torres (miguel.torres@lumenhealth.com). Miguel prefers early mornings PST (08:00–10:00) for deep-dive calls.
- Attaching our current high-level topology (lumen-network-topology-v1.pdf).

Requests / asks:
- Please send the MoAP and a short list of evidence items you'll need for audit (SOC2 artifacts, encryption attestations).
- For the POC we'll need a short statement on how Redwood handles KV caching and whether caching can be restricted to customer-owned KMS sessions.

I'll loop Miguel on the scheduling once we have proposed times. We may also involve procurement for contracting questions — I'll flag if they need to join the next call.

Thanks,
Karina Lopez
Senior IT Program Manager, Integrations
LumenHealth
karina.lopez@lumenhealth.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Recap from today — quick internal alignment notes

Sean / Marissa — quick notes to align before the deep-dive:
- Marissa: can you own the tech deep-dive with Miguel + team. We should bring an infra engineer who can speak to KMS integrations and the options (customer KMS, HSM proxy, or Redwood-managed with CMK wrap).
- Prep checklist: send lumen-network-topology-v1.pdf back with our annotated firewall/port list; include both PrivateLink and ExpressRoute peering options in the MoAP.
- Pricing guidance: recommend proposing a Reserved Capacity pilot for the POC (2 x GPU nodes) + networking & managed private link add-on. Keep the POC commitment line-itemized so procurement can sign-off faster.
- Legal / procurement likely to request limited data retention and SOC2 evidence — loop in legal early if they ask for custom data retention terms.

I attached the network-requirements-template.pdf we use for these flows — use it as the pre-call worksheet. Also add the redwood-privacy-brief.pdf (already in Sean's outbound).

Action items for Sean:
- Send Karina the filled template and MoAP draft today (or first thing tomorrow).
- Propose two confirmed times for Miguel and lock the call (Vanessa recommends Mon 12/14 08:30 or Tue 12/15 09:00 PST).

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Solutions 
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Karina Lopez <karina.lopez@lumenhealth.com>, Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, LumenHealth IT <it@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Confirming deep-dive and next deliverables (MoAP + annotated topology)

Karina / Miguel — thanks for the quick responses. Per Vanessa and Marissa's notes, confirming the immediate commitments and asking for a final attendee list for the deep-dive:

Redwood deliverables (by EOD 12/14 unless noted)
- MoAP (mutual action plan) draft with POC milestones and owners — link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/78932 (will upload final after your review).
- Annotated network requirements (using the attached template) — please fill the template where you can; we'll annotate with our recommended firewall/IP allowlist and peering options.
- SOC2 / privacy evidence list and the redwood-privacy-brief.pdf (attached).

Proposed deep-dive times (PST) — please confirm one:
- Mon 12/14 08:30–09:45 (preferred by Miguel)
- Tue 12/15 09:00–10:30

Attendees requested from LumenHealth: Miguel Torres (network ops), one security/compliance owner, and a procurement contact if contracting questions are expected.

Two quick technical clarifications you asked about:
1) KV caching: we can run with cache disabled for the POC or scope cache to a customer-managed KMS key. Marissa will bring specifics to the deep-dive.
2) Egress: we support private peering and static egress IPs — we'll map options in the annotated topology.

If those look good, I'll send the MoAP + the template now and lock the meeting. I can also attach a short pricing stub for the Reserved Capacity pilot for procurement to review.

Best,
